summary: Iteration 4: Verified Bulk Assign COLONIES dialog fix (backend endpoints + UI). All 3 backend pytest cases pass (GET /admin/colonies BHD/THS returns union of ward+colony; block-assign-colonies matches by colony field; block-unassign-colonies clears). Frontend UI verified end-to-end: dialog no longer stuck on 'Loading colonies...', lists BHD Colony 0 / BHD Colony 1, search shows no-match message for missing colony, full assign flow (colony + surveyor + Assign) returns 200 and success toast; table refreshes showing 'Rahul Surveyor' on BHD-0002/BHD-0004. Regression: Bulk Assign by Area dialog (data-testid=bulk-area-select) still works and lists BHD colonies. Surveyor1 employee/properties map renders mixed-colour pins (green/yellow/red) after ~20s.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /admin/properties?colony=<name> currently returns all town properties (5) instead of only colony-matching (2). Filter on ?colony query param appears not applied at DB layer. Not part of this review scope but worth checking.

GET /admin/colonies response shape differs from historical convention: returns {colonies: [...]} object rather than a bare list. Frontend already handles both, but consider standardizing across list-style endpoints.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing BHD seed: 5 colony-only properties BHD-0001..0005). After tests, BHD Colony 0 assigned to Rahul Surveyor (surveyor1). If cleanup desired, main agent can call block-unassign-colonies for BHD Colony 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk Assign Colonies dialog fix verified fully. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_bulk_assign_colonies_iter4.py is reusable regression. Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL; auth login returns {token, refresh_token, user} - key is 'token' not 'access_token'.
